active_debt_horizon.note: Active period count = maturity_period_index - repayment_start_period_index + 1. No hardcoded 28 or 2044.

merchant_debt_periods.note: Operating periods within active debt horizon where is_ppa_active=False. These are the 4 causal merchant periods for bank-sizing CFADS.

post_maturity_causality.note: Periods 30-61 are outside the active Senior Debt horizon. The DSCR solver computes the minimum DSCR only over active debt periods (2-29). Post-maturity periods are not inputs to the DSCR binding constraint computation. The debt_size_keur is determined by the binding DSCR period within the active horizon.
